teaser: A composer's agent: a plan to read a piano PDF into Sibelius, then the composer's handwriting, with MusicXML in the middle and a check.
core_idea: A composer wants an agent that reads a piano PDF into Sibelius and later their own handwriting; the plan keeps MusicXML in the middle, uses an OMR engine or the model to recognise the page, checks by rendering the MusicXML back and comparing with the page, then drives Sibelius only where it must, by plugin or Sibelius Connect before the screen; a scheduled Claude session connected by Remote Control does the work, keeping every page and correction in a vault so handwriting improves from the composer's own examples; four MVPs in order.
